description: HeroicLands dependency updates: one patch PR and one minor PR per repository each Sunday morning, majors separate.

packageRules.description: Peer ranges widen so a published package keeps accepting the versions it already accepted.
Every patch update of a repository in one PR; its checks gate the scheduled merge and heroiclands-bot approves it.
Every minor update of a repository in one PR, left for the owner.
A major update is its own PR and is never merged automatically.

Every action a workflow uses is pinned to a full commit SHA. The runner re-fetches an action named by a branch or tag on every job, and concurrent fetches corrupt its cached copy; a pinned action is fetched once.
Action pins and digest updates join the patch group: the code they point at is unchanged by pinning, and a HeroicLands/.github digest carries changes already reviewed there.

This repository's own reusable workflows call its actions at main, so a fix reaches every caller at once, as its workflow-parity test requires. Renovate leaves those references alone here; other repositories still pin HeroicLands/.github by digest.
TypeScript stays below 7: the 7.x package is the native compiler and carries no JavaScript compiler API, which package-build's schema extraction and declaration check, and TypeDoc, call at runtime.
